criteria.status: Building F / 143 identity is strongly cross-checked; GIS ring remains a pre-planning roof/wall proxy, not an as-built survey
evidence: Tippecanoe County approved construction-plan sheet C1.4 labels the central block BLDG F / 143 between BLDG E / 144 and BLDG G / 142. The sheet is a detailed site/construction plan but is not georeferenced or an as-built wall survey.

Purdue GIS FID 506 is Building F / abbreviation 143, with layer 'BLDG Building Pre-planning'; its address field is blank and the feature is pre-planning. The no-warp overlay of its transformed ring follows the central Building F roof in Indiana's 2025 orthophoto.

The stable .005 assignment is supported by the inherited proxy center: FID 506 centroid is 10.84 m away, while next-nearest FID 501 / Building E is 44.11 m away. Plan label and current imagery independently corroborate this crosswalk.

The 32 model base-ring vertices reproduce Purdue GIS FID 506 after the documented transformation within 0.000059 m maximum residual. The orthophoto outlines roof/eaves, so exact structural wall registration remains uncertain.
findings: Retain explicit uncertainty that the pre-planning GIS and orthophoto roof outline are not a surveyed as-built wall line.

criteria.status: candidate plan geometry and campus placement are corroborated by site plan and current roof imagery; exact wall dimensions are approximate
evidence: Blender 5.2.3 reopened mesh bounds are X -1573.270..-1523.543 m, Y -468.006..-447.472 m and Z 0.000..11.400 m. The transformed GIS structural candidate envelope is 49.73 m by 19.28 m.

Plan C1.4 supplies the neighboring block order and orientation; the no-fit 2025 orthophoto overlay shows close registration with the central roof. The plan is not georeferenced, and campus XY uses a local approximation; neither source confirms the exact exterior wall line.
findings: Use the reported footprint dimensions as approximate until a wall survey or georeferenced as-built plan is available; facade projections/roof eaves can differ from the base ring.

criteria.criterion: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.status: three stories and repeated gables have project-level evidence; heights, segmentation and pitch are estimates
evidence: Studio M's project description says the community has seven three-story buildings, supporting the model's storey count at development level. Project photos show repeated gabled forms, and the current orthophoto roof has a repeated segmented/gable pattern.
The model uses 8.9 m eaves and 11.4 m ridge, both estimates with documented ±1.5 m uncertainty. No building-specific elevation or measured vertical source was found.
The five-break roof rhythm is consistent with imagery at a broad level, but ridge positions, pitch, exact gable count and the roof-to-facade alignment are not measured for this individual block.
findings: Keep 8.9 m eaves, 11.4 m ridge and the five-segment roof layout labeled as estimates; no building-specific elevation validates them.

criteria.status: general apartment facade vocabulary is supported; detail placement and color/composition are generalized
evidence: Studio M project photos support brick facades, dark framed windows/glazing, selected balconies, accent bays, shallow entry canopies and repeated gables at the development level.

The rebuilt render includes window frames/mullions, three accent bays, selected balconies and two glazed entries/canopies. These elements now convey more of the project character, but the photos do not label Building F; exact locations, counts and rhythm are generalized. The render's facade tone and large blank end wall are not verified against a Building F elevation.
No building-specific facade schedule, elevation or entrance map is included; the site-plan sheet does not document facade elements.
findings: Treat facade feature positions, material/color, and exact opening rhythm as schematic until an attributable Building F elevation or photo is available.

crosswalk.method: Crosschecked legacy target location against all Purdue GIS Provenance plan-feature centroids, then required independent explicit county-plan label plus current orthophoto overlay before assigning the individual building.
crosswalk.crosswalk_conclusion: FID 506 is the nearest mapped apartment building to the inherited .005 object center by 33.27 m over the next-nearest FID 501 (Building E). It is explicitly labeled BLDG F / 143 on county construction-plan sheet C1.4, between BLDG E / 144 and BLDG G / 142. A no-warp overlay of the transformed FID 506 ring aligns closely with the central Building F roof outline in Indiana 2025 orthophoto. These independent sources support the stable .005-to-Building F identity; the previous model's broad bounds are only a rough center and not wall geometry.
remaining_limitations: Purdue GIS FID 506 remains tagged BLDG Building Pre-planning; the available County packet is an approved detailed construction-plan / stormwater sheet, not an as-built survey.
The orthophoto roof/eave boundary is not identical to a surveyed exterior wall line.
Building-specific elevation and facade schedule remain unavailable; height and facade composition retain explicit estimates/generalization.

recommendation: The asset scores 7.1/10. The County C1.4 label and current orthophoto make the Building F/143 crosswalk substantially stronger than the prior review, and its candidate plan location is well supported. Wall-line registration remains approximate; verticals and roof segmentation are estimated; facade positions are generalized; and the shared manifest bounds still need coordinator reconciliation.
